messages:
cass_marketing: Quick thread 1: Need a compact pocket battlecard + 3 lightning SDR opens for inbound routing. Target: dev/platform buyers comparing Redwood vs cloud-managed endpoints and pure LLM APIs. Keep claims legal-safe (no absolutes).
noah_sales: I'll drop two rapid opens: 
1) 'Hey — teams using managed endpoints are surprised by token surprises. We help make inference costs predictable with a single runtime and clear unit economics. 10 min?'
2) 'If your infra team needs locked-down deployments, we run in your VPC with the same API surface  saves lift.'
zara_product: Suggested pocket bullets for card: 
- Economics: deterministic unit costs (batching + cache transparency)
- Latency: p95/p99 SLOs with regional routing + fallback models
- Ops: same API for hosted/dedicated/private, easy rollbacks, model pinning
- Risk: private deployment + KMS integration for regulated data
liam_growth: Webinar hook: 'Benchmarking inference: reproducible tests, not vendor anecdotes.' Slide callouts: test harness link, workload profile examples, and one customer vignette (anonymized). Also recommend a short poll in registration: "what's your biggest inference pain? cost/latency/deploy".
megan_legal: Reminder: use 'help', 'reduce', 'up to' phrasing. No competitor product names. For customer anecdotes, use anonymized metrics or ranges and get legal sign-off before publishing.
noah_sales: Quick objection handling soundbites: 
- IT/Security: 'We support VPC, HSM/KMS, and audit logs.'
- Procurement: 'Reserved capacity with commitment tiers + SLA options.'
- Devs: 'drop-in SDKs and migration examples; 30m pilot available.'
cass_marketing: SDR scripts - lightning variants (SaaS, Platform, Enterprise): 
```
SaaS: 'Hey <name>, curious if you've benchmarked token spend on managed endpoints. We helped a similar team reduce per-token spend via caching. Quick sync?'
Platform: 'We provide a single runtime you can run in your cloud or ours so your teams avoid per-team infra sprawl. 10-min intro?'
Enterprise: 'We support private control planes, KMS integrations, and enterprise rollouts with SLAs. Can I connect you with solutions?'
```
ops_bot: field-guide: https://internal.redwood/field/pocket-battlecard-v3 (last updated 1724990000)
zara_product: For the card visual: 3-column mini-matrix (Economics | Latency | Deploy Flex). Under each, Redwood: 1 short phrase; Cloud-managed: 1 short limitation; API-only: 1 short tradeoff. I'll sketch in Figma and share link.
cass_marketing: Great. Action items: 
- @zara_product: Figma mini-card + one-sentence bullets by EOD
- @noah_sales: SDR opens + 3 objection lines by EOD
- @liam_growth: webinar registration poll + 2 slide headlines by tomorrow AM
- @megan_legal: legal pass on final copy before publish
I'll assemble the pocket PDF and a short email template for inbound routing. Thanks :sparkles:
